summary: Choose a quantity and add a tool to my basket
description: Consumables are bought several at a time. The quantity chosen on the product page is the quantity that has to reach the basket — getting this wrong costs a customer money.
acceptanceCriteria: A product page opens with the quantity set to 1.
Increasing the quantity twice from its starting value sets it to 3.
Adding a product to the basket shows the basket control in the navigation.
The basket holds the quantity that was chosen on the product page.
